title: Immune recruitment across blood cohorts and macrophage composition in inflammatory neuropathies
description: Final manuscript, supplementary information, analysis code and figure source data for immune recruitment across blood cohorts and macrophage composition in inflammatory neuropathies. The materials include external blood reanalyses, an independent CIDP versus vasculitic neuropathy whole-nerve comparison, and macrophage composition sensitivity analyses. There are five main figures, twelve supplementary figures and Supplementary Data 1–6. This editorial revision clarifies the analysis sequence and figure displays without changing statistical results. Use current/ for the current manuscript and figures. Public source datasets retain their attribution and terms.
